dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Apr 22 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pu7q](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pu7q) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 202.138 depth occurred on Apr 22 2025 17km SW of Long Island. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -5.4843 longitude 147.0064. It impacted 5376 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
